thesis: The speaker argues that earning transformational returns requires extraordinary patience, as historic equity re-ratings often take 10 to 40 years to generate results while enduring significant volatility and periods where nothing happens. He further contends that the standard fund structure, which demands frequent performance reporting and faces instability from limited partners pulling money during trouble, makes it nearly impossible for funds to capture these types of long-term returns.
